sponsorsystem.error.unavailable: The sponsorship system is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.
sponsorsystem.error.players_only: Only a player can run this command. From the console, use /sponsorship instead.
sponsorsystem.error.not_in_tree: %s is not part of the sponsorship tree.
sponsorsystem.error.self_not_in_tree: You are not part of the sponsorship tree yet. An operator can add you with /sponsorship adopt.
sponsorsystem.error.private: You can only look at your own invites on this server.
sponsorsystem.error.save_failed: Could not save the sponsorship tree, so nothing was changed. Check the server log.
sponsorsystem.error.lookup.invalid_name: %s is not a valid Minecraft username.
sponsorsystem.error.lookup.not_found: There is no Minecraft account called %s.
sponsorsystem.error.lookup.unavailable: Could not verify %s right now. Try again in a moment.
sponsorsystem.error.lookup.offline_mode: This server is in offline mode, so usernames cannot be verified. An operator must enable allowOfflineModeUuids in the config.
sponsorsystem.invite.success: %s is now whitelisted, and you are their sponsor. What they do is on you.
sponsorsystem.invite.already: %s is already in the tree, sponsored by %s.
sponsorsystem.invite.already_root: %s is already in the tree as a root, with no sponsor.
sponsorsystem.invite.limit: You have used all %s of your invites. Revoke one with /uninvite before inviting anyone else.
sponsorsystem.invite.cooldown: You invited someone recently. Try again in %s minute(s).
sponsorsystem.invite.playtime: You need %s minute(s) of playtime before you can invite anyone. You have %s.
sponsorsystem.invite.not_in_tree: You are not part of the sponsorship tree, so you cannot sponsor anyone. Ask an operator to add you with /sponsorship adopt.
sponsorsystem.invite.self_revoked: Your own sponsorship has been revoked, so you cannot vouch for anyone else.
sponsorsystem.invite.bootstrapped: The sponsorship tree had no entry for you, so you have been added as a root.
sponsorsystem.invite.cycle: %s is above you in the tree, so sponsoring them would create a loop.
sponsorsystem.uninvite.not_yours: %s was not invited by you. Only their sponsor can revoke them.
sponsorsystem.uninvite.success_cascade: You revoked your sponsorship of %s, which also removed %s player(s) they had invited.
sponsorsystem.kick.revoked: %2$s revoked their sponsorship of %1$s. Ask them if you want back in.
sponsorsystem.kick.revoked_by_admin: An operator revoked the sponsorship of %s.
sponsorsystem.kick.expired: Your invite expired before you used it. Ask your sponsor to invite you again.
sponsorsystem.sponsor.is_root: They are a root of the tree and have no sponsor.
sponsorsystem.admin.reload.warnings: %s problem(s) were repaired while loading. See the server log.
sponsorsystem.admin.reload.failed: Could not read sponsors.json. The tree was left as it was; check the server log.
sponsorsystem.admin.adopt.root: Adopted %s into the tree as a root.
sponsorsystem.admin.adopt.under: Adopted %s into the tree, sponsored by %s.
sponsorsystem.admin.error.cycle: That would put %s below themselves in the tree.
sponsorsystem.admin.error.already: %s already has a sponsor. Use /sponsorship reassign to move them.
sponsorsystem.admin.error.sponsor_revoke: That sponsor has been revoked. Adopt or reassign them first, or pick a different sponsor.
sponsorsystem.admin.stats.whitelist: Whitelisted: %s, of which %s have no sponsor.
sponsorsystem.admin.stats.orphan_hint: Bring those into the tree with /sponsorship adopt <player> [sponsor].
sponsorsystem.admin.stats.whitelist_off: The whitelist is currently OFF, so none of this is being enforced.
sponsorsystem.configuration.title: Sponsorship
sponsorsystem.configuration.cascadeOnRev: Cascade revocations to the whole branch
